note: Tier manifest for the resource governor — Clara-tuned (fresh instance). nominal_tier is the static baseline (super-critical | critical | important | less-important | frill). in_use_boost bumps a component that is actively serving. priority_floor is the lowest tier the governor will ever shed; untagged = unsheddable (fails closed). kill_requires: 'autonomous' (only frill, and only with restart_cmd present) | 'conscious' (needs blast-radius token) | 'never'.

components.name: sqlite-memory
components.note: memory.db / secrets.db / state.db / logs.db — everything rides on this. Never shed.

components.name: pi-harness
components.note: The agent harness I run in. Never shed.

components.name: reasoning-model
components.note: Primary reasoning model (default deepseek-v4-flash@low). Not a local process; not shedable by signal.

components.name: memory-worker
components.note: Background memory workers. Active use boosts to protected.

components.name: freeroam-subconscious
components.note: My subconscious/freeroam loop. frill-tier but NEVER parked and NEVER killed. Cron-invoked short-lived batch job; under pressure the governor may only DEFER a scheduled run, never permanently stop it.

components.name: fastembed-embeddings
components.note: Local embedding model for recall. Non-critical; re-runs on demand.

components.name: intel-gym
components.note: World-forecasting gym. Cron-invoked, short-lived; freezeable under pressure.
